# Written by mods/integration_fix/tools/generate.py from the game's own file. Do not edit.
# from in_game/common/subject_types/appanage.txt
REPLACE:appanage = { 
	subject_pays = subject_pays_vassal
	color = subject_appanage
	annullment_favours_required = 30
	level = 3
	join_offensive_wars_always = {
		NOR = {
			scope:actor ?= { is_subject_of = scope:recipient }
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = has_not_been_exempted_tt
				scope:recipient ?= { has_variable = demanded_exemption_longterm_variable }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = french_subject_prevented_from_call_to_war_join_war_tt
				scope:recipient ?= { modifier:french_subject_prevented_from_call_to_war = yes }
			}
		}
	}

	#root = subject type, scope:actor = caller, scope:recipient = callee, scope:target (optional) = against who)
	join_defensive_wars_always = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = french_subject_prevented_from_call_to_war_join_war_tt
			NOT = { scope:recipient ?= { modifier:french_subject_prevented_from_call_to_war = yes } }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = wont_join_vs_other_appanages_with_granted_autonomy_to_expand_modifier_during_hyw_tt
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
					scope:target ?= { has_country_modifier = granted_autonomy_to_expand_modifier }
				}
				always = no
			}
			trigger_else = {
				always = yes
			}
		}
	}
	#root = subject type scope:overlord = overlord in relation scope:subject = subject in relation scope:attacker = country that wants to attack (will be either overlord or subject), scope:defender = country they want to attack)
	can_attack = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = has_demanded_autonomy_tt
			OR = {
				AND = {
					scope:attacker = { has_country_modifier = granted_autonomy_to_expand_modifier }
					trigger_if = {
						limit = { exists = scope:defender.overlord }
						scope:attacker.overlord ?= scope:defender.overlord
					}
					trigger_else = {
						always = no
					}
				}
				scope:attacker.overlord ?= scope:defender
			}
		}
	}
	has_overlords_ruler = no
	will_join_independence_wars = yes 
	annexation_speed = 1
	annexation_min_years_before = 15
	annexation_min_opinion = 190
	annexation_stall_opinion = 175
	subject_can_cancel = no
	overlord_can_cancel = no
	overlord_inherit_if_no_heir = yes
	
	allow_declaring_wars = { always = yes }
	has_limited_diplomacy = yes
	fleet_basing_rights = yes
	food_access = yes
	
	can_change_rank = no
	can_change_heir_selection = yes

	minimum_opinion_for_offer = 200

	great_power_score_transfer = 0.25
	
	strength_vs_overlord = -0.40
	
	diplomatic_capacity_cost_scale = 0.25
	
	
	can_overlord_build_roads = yes
	can_overlord_build_buildings = yes
	can_overlord_build_rgos = yes
	
	institution_spread_to_overlord = monthly_institution_spread_moderate
	institution_spread_to_subject = monthly_institution_spread_moderate
	
	overlord_modifier = {
		stability_decay = 0.001
		monthly_legitimacy = 0.03
		global_crown_estate_power = -0.033
		global_nobles_estate_power = 0.025
		global_levy_size_modifier = -0.025
	}
	subject_modifier = {
		monthly_prestige = 0.1
	}
	
	creation_visible = {
		government_type = government_type:monarchy
		has_reform = government_reform:french_feudal_nobility
	}

	subject_creation_enabled = {
		government_type = government_type:monarchy
		has_reform = government_reform:french_feudal_nobility

		scope:target_province = { region = region:france_region }
	}
	
	release_country_enabled = {
		government_type = government_type:monarchy
		has_reform = government_reform:french_feudal_nobility

		scope:target = {
			capital = { region = region:france_region }
			culture = { has_culture_group = culture_group:french_group }
		}
	}

	visible = {
		government_type = government_type:monarchy
		has_reform = government_reform:french_feudal_nobility
		scope:target = {
			government_type = government_type:monarchy
			OR = {
				capital.region = region:france_region
				capital.area = area:brabant_area
				capital.area = area:flanders_area
				capital.area = area:holland_area
				culture = { has_culture_group = culture_group:french_group }
				AND = {
					has_or_had_tag = NAV
					has_variable = nav_appanage_rights_granted
				}			
			}
		}		
	}

	enabled = {
		scope:target = {
			is_subject_of = root		
			government_type = government_type:monarchy
			OR = {
				capital.region = region:france_region
				capital.area = area:brabant_area
				capital.area = area:flanders_area
				capital.area = area:holland_area
				culture = { has_culture_group = culture_group:french_group }
				AND = {
					has_or_had_tag = NAV
					has_variable = nav_appanage_rights_granted
				}
			}			
			exists = root.ruler_or_heir_if_regent.dynasty
			exists = ruler_or_heir_if_regent
			OR = {
				ruler_or_heir_if_regent = { is_patrilineal_descendant_of = root.ruler_or_heir_if_regent.dynasty }
				AND = {
					root.ruler_or_heir_if_regent = { is_patrilineal_descendant_of = dynasty:capet_dynasty }
					ruler_or_heir_if_regent = { is_patrilineal_descendant_of = dynasty:capet_dynasty }
				}
				heir ?= { is_patrilineal_descendant_of = root.ruler_or_heir_if_regent.dynasty }
				AND = {
					root.ruler_or_heir_if_regent = { is_patrilineal_descendant_of = dynasty:capet_dynasty }
					heir ?= { is_patrilineal_descendant_of = dynasty:capet_dynasty }
				}
				AND = {
					has_or_had_tag = NAV
					has_variable = nav_appanage_rights_granted
				}
			}
		}	
	}	

	on_enable = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				government_reform:french_appanage_reform = { is_available_for = root }
			}
			add_reform = government_reform:french_appanage_reform
		}
	}
	
	diplo_chance_accept_subject = { # Should never appear in normal gameplay but set to -9999 in case
		base = -9999
	}
	
	diplo_chance_accept_overlord = { # Should never appear in normal gameplay but set to -9999 in case
		base = -9999
	}

	ai_wants_to_be_overlord = {
        scope:subject ?= {
			add = {
                desc = "COALITION_GRADE_ANTAGONISM_TOWARDS_THEM_SUBJECT"
                value = {
                    every_country_with_coalition_grade_antagonism_against_us = {                    
                        add = {
                            value = -10
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
	}
}

# from in_game/common/subject_types/dominion.txt
REPLACE:dominion = { # like a personal union except the subject has much less power
	subject_pays = subject_pays_vassal
	color = subject_dominion
	level = 3
	annullment_favours_required = 30

	join_offensive_wars_always = {
		NOT = { scope:actor ?= { is_subject_of = scope:recipient } }
	}
	join_offensive_wars_can_call = {
		scope:actor ?= { is_subject_of = scope:recipient }
	}
	join_defensive_wars_always = {
		always = yes
	}
	has_overlords_ruler = yes
	has_overlords_religion = yes
	annexation_speed = 1
	annexation_min_years_before = 50
	annexation_min_opinion = 150
	annexation_stall_opinion = 125
	subject_can_cancel = no
	overlord_can_cancel = yes
	has_limited_diplomacy = yes

	allow_declaring_wars = { 
		lordship_of_ireland_can_declare_wars_trigger = yes
	}

	war_score_cost = 0.5	
	
	strength_vs_overlord = -0.25
	diplomatic_capacity_cost_scale = 0.5
	maritime_path_tolerance = -0.2

	only_overlord_court_language = yes
	only_overlord_or_kindred_culture = yes

	can_change_rank = no
	can_change_heir_selection = no
	
	minimum_opinion_for_offer = 175
	
	fleet_basing_rights = yes
	food_access = yes
	subject_exempt_from_overlord_import_tariffs = yes
	overlord_exempt_from_subject_import_tariffs = yes

	great_power_score_transfer = 0.5 # the amount of Great Power Score that is transferred from the Subject to the Overlord

	institution_spread_to_overlord = monthly_institution_spread_severe
	institution_spread_to_subject = monthly_institution_spread_severe
	
	overlord_modifier = {
		monthly_prestige = 0.01
	}
	subject_modifier = {
		legislative_efficiency = 0.1
		blocked_from_conversion = yes
	}

	creation_visible = {
		OR = {
			has_or_had_tag = ENG
			has_or_had_tag = GBR
		}
		trigger_if = {
			limit = {
				exists = country_rank_level
				exists = scope:target.country_rank_level
			}
			country_rank_level >= scope:target.country_rank_level
		}
	}

	subject_creation_enabled = {
		government_type = government_type:monarchy
	}

	release_country_enabled = {
		government_type = government_type:monarchy
	}

	visible = {
		OR = {
			and = {
				exists = ruler
				exists = scope:target.ruler
				ruler = scope:target.ruler
			}
			has_or_had_tag = ENG
			has_or_had_tag = GBR
		}
		religion.group = scope:target.religion.group
		government_type = government_type:monarchy
		
		#Japanese Imperial Courts Exception
		trigger_if = {
			limit = {
				is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:japanese_shogunate
				is_situation_active = situation:nanbokuchou
			}
			NOT = {
				scope:target = {
					has_special_status_in_international_organization = {
						type = special_status:japanese_emperor
						international_organization = international_organization:japanese_shogunate
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	visible_through_diplomacy = {
		OR = {
			in_union_with = scope:target
			has_or_had_tag = ENG
			has_or_had_tag = GBR
		}
	}

	visible_through_treaty = {
		OR = {
			in_union_with = scope:target
			has_or_had_tag = ENG
			has_or_had_tag = GBR
		}
	}

	enabled = {
		religion.group = scope:target.religion.group
		trigger_if = {
			limit = {
				in_union_with = scope:target
			}
			union_length_days = {
				target = scope:target
				value > 18250
			}
			relative_strength = {
				target = scope:target
				value > 0.7
			}
		}
	}

	on_enable = {		
		if = {
			limit = {
				culture = {
					NOR = {
						this = scope:future_overlord.culture
						reverse_cultural_view = { target = scope:future_overlord.culture value = kindred }
					}					
				}
			}
			change_culture = scope:future_overlord.culture
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				and = {
					exists = court_language
					court_language != scope:future_overlord.court_language
				}
			}
			set_court_language = scope:future_overlord.court_dialect
		}
	}

	diplo_chance_accept_subject = {
		base = -72
		
		
		current_strength = 0.2
		border_distance = -0.3
		negative_opinion = -5
		positive_opinion = 0.25
		rank_difference = -5
		giving_defensive_support = 2
		receiving_defensive_support = 5
		royal_ties = 1
		trust_in_actor = 0.2

		num_of_limited_subjects = -5
		culture_war = 3
		diplomatic_reputation = 0.8
		different_religion = -20
		same_common_language = 5
		same_court_language = 10
		different_culture = -10
		different_government_type = -50
		actor_at_war = -20
		competing_power = -200
		tax_base = -0.25
		
		reject_subjugation_reasons = -1
		accept_subjugation_reasons = 1
	}

	diplo_chance_accept_overlord = {
		base = 10
		border_distance = -0.3
		negative_opinion = -5
		positive_opinion = 0.25
		same_common_language = 5
		same_court_language = 10
		different_culture = -10
		different_government_type = -25
		actor_at_war = -20
		competing_power = -200
		trust_in_actor = 0.2
	}

	ai_wants_to_be_overlord = {
        scope:subject ?= {
			add = {
                desc = "COALITION_GRADE_ANTAGONISM_TOWARDS_THEM_SUBJECT"
                value = {
                    every_country_with_coalition_grade_antagonism_against_us = {                    
                        add = {
                            value = -10
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
	}
}

	subject_pays = subject_pays_vassal

	level = 3
	annullment_favours_required = 30
	join_offensive_wars_always = {

	}
	join_offensive_wars_can_call = {
		scope:actor ?= { is_subject_of = scope:recipient }
	}
	join_defensive_wars_always = {
		always = yes
	}
	has_overlords_ruler = yes
	has_overlords_religion = yes
	annexation_speed = 1
	annexation_min_years_before = 10
	annexation_min_opinion = 150

	overlord_can_cancel = yes

	can_change_heir_selection = no
	
	minimum_opinion_for_offer = 150
	
	has_limited_diplomacy = yes
	fleet_basing_rights = yes
	food_access = yes
	
	great_power_score_transfer = 0.25 # the amount of Great Power Score that is transferred from the Subject to the Overlord
	
	institution_spread_to_overlord = monthly_institution_spread_severe
	institution_spread_to_subject = monthly_institution_spread_severe
	
	overlord_modifier = {
		monthly_towards_decentralization = societal_value_tiny_monthly_move
	}

	subject_modifier = {
		loyalty_to_overlord = 10
		pure_tooltip_entry = pte_not_blocked_from_conversion		# blocked_from_conversion = no
	}

	creation_visible = {
		government_type = government_type:monarchy
	}

	subject_creation_enabled = {
		has_ruler = yes
	}

	release_country_enabled = {
		has_ruler = yes
	}

	visible = {
		has_ruler = yes
		religion.group = scope:target.religion.group
		government_type = government_type:monarchy
		# High Kingship members can subjugate each other regardless of rank
		OR = {
			country_rank_level >= scope:target.country_rank_level
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:high_kingship
				any_international_organization_member = {
					this = scope:target
				}
			}
		}
		
		#Japanese Imperial Courts Exception
		trigger_if = {
			limit = {
				is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:japanese_shogunate
				is_situation_active = situation:nanbokuchou
			}
			NOT = {
				scope:target = {
					has_special_status_in_international_organization = {
						type = special_status:japanese_emperor
						international_organization = international_organization:japanese_shogunate
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	visible_through_treaty = {
		scope:target = {
			government_type = government_type:monarchy
		}
	}

	enabled_through_diplomacy = {
		scope:target = { 
			government_type = government_type:monarchy
			OR = {
				ruler ?= root.ruler
				regent ?= root.ruler
				and = {
					has_regent = yes
					has_heir = no
				}
			}
		}
	}

	diplo_chance_accept_subject = {
		base = -92
		
		
		current_strength = 0.2
		border_distance = -0.3
		negative_opinion = -5
		positive_opinion = 0.25
		rank_difference = -5
		giving_defensive_support = 2
		receiving_defensive_support = 5
		royal_ties = 1
		
		num_of_limited_subjects = -5
		culture_war = 3
		diplomatic_reputation = 0.8
		different_religion = -20
		same_common_language = 5
		same_court_language = 10
		different_culture = -10
		different_government_type = -25
		actor_at_war = -20
		competing_power = -200
		tax_base = -0.25
		trust_in_actor = 0.2
		
		reject_subjugation_reasons = -1
		accept_subjugation_reasons = 1
	}

	diplo_chance_accept_overlord = {
		base = 8
		border_distance = -0.3
		negative_opinion = -5
		positive_opinion = 0.25
		same_common_language = 5
		same_court_language = 10
		different_culture = -10
		different_government_type = -25
		actor_at_war = -20
		competing_power = -200
	}

# from in_game/common/subject_types/hanseatic_member.txt
REPLACE:hanseatic_member = { 
	subject_pays = hanseatic_member_cost
	color = subject_hanseatic_member
	level = 2
	annullment_favours_required = 20
	join_offensive_wars_always = {
		always = yes
	}
	join_defensive_wars_always = {
		#protect against external threats
		scope:actor ?= {
			is_subject_of = scope:recipient
		}
		scope:target ?= {
			NOT = { is_subject_of = scope:recipient }
		}
	}
	has_overlords_ruler = no
	will_join_independence_wars = yes
	can_be_annexed = no

	institution_spread_to_subject = monthly_institution_spread_severe

		global_merchant_capacity_modifier = 0.025
	}

		selling_efficiency = small_selling_efficiency_bonus
		merchant_maintenance_efficiency = 0.20
		max_tariff = 0.05
		loyalty_to_overlord = 30
	}

	creation_visible = {
		always = no
	}

	visible = {
		tag = HSA
	}

	visible_through_treaty = {
		scope:target = {
			num_of_non_rural > 0
			num_locations_owned_or_owned_by_subjects < 5
		}
	}

	enabled_through_treaty = {
		scope:target = {
			num_of_non_rural > 0
			num_locations_owned_or_owned_by_subjects < 5
		}
	}

	enabled_through_diplomacy = {
		scope:target = {
			num_of_non_rural > 0
			num_locations_owned_or_owned_by_subjects < 5
		}
	}

	diplo_chance_accept_subject = {
		base = -50
		negative_opinion = -5
		positive_opinion = 0.25
		diplomatic_reputation = 0.8
		num_of_subjects = -1
		same_common_language = 5
		different_religion_group = -10
		different_culture = -5
		same_government_type = 5
		trust_in_actor = 0.2
		capital_distance = -0.075
		in_debt = 2
		relative_tax_base = 20
		trade_income_percentage = 20
		urban_population_percentage = 20
		different_culture_group = -15
		location_count = -2
		foreign_buildings_owned_by_actor = 2.5
	}
	
	diplo_chance_accept_overlord = {
		base = 8
		border_distance = -0.5
		negative_opinion = -5
		positive_opinion = 0.25
		trust_in_actor = 0.2
	}
}

# from in_game/common/subject_types/march.txt
REPLACE:march = { 
	subject_pays = subject_pays_march
	color = subject_march
	level = 1
	annullment_favours_required = 10
	visible = {
		# High Kingship members can subjugate each other regardless of rank
		OR = {
			country_rank_level >= scope:target.country_rank_level
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:high_kingship
				any_international_organization_member = {
					this = scope:target
				}
			}
		}
		scope:target = { subject_type_is_not_locked = yes }
		
		#Japanese Imperial Courts Exception
		trigger_if = {
			limit = {
				is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:japanese_shogunate
				is_situation_active = situation:nanbokuchou
			}
			NOT = {
				scope:target = {
					has_special_status_in_international_organization = {
						type = special_status:japanese_emperor
						international_organization = international_organization:japanese_shogunate
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	
	join_offensive_wars_always = {
		always = yes
	}
	join_defensive_wars_always = {
		#protect against external threats
		scope:actor ?= {
			is_subject_of = scope:recipient
		}
		scope:target ?= {
			NOT = { is_subject_of = scope:recipient }
		}
	}
	has_overlords_ruler = no
	will_join_independence_wars = yes
	can_be_annexed = no

	overlord_can_cancel = yes

	diplomatic_capacity_cost_scale = 1.0
	maritime_path_tolerance = -0.25
	
	
	can_overlord_build_roads = yes
	can_overlord_build_buildings = yes
	can_overlord_build_rgos = yes
	
	
	can_overlord_recruit_regiments = yes
    can_overlord_build_ships = yes
	fleet_basing_rights = yes

	
	has_limited_diplomacy = yes
	
	can_change_rank = no
	can_change_heir_selection = yes

		#Japanese Imperial Courts Exception
		trigger_if = {
			limit = {
				is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:japanese_shogunate
				is_situation_active = situation:nanbokuchou
			}
			NOT = {
				scope:target = {
					has_special_status_in_international_organization = {
						type = special_status:japanese_emperor
						international_organization = international_organization:japanese_shogunate
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

		can_country_have_tusi = yes

				region = region:west_china_region

				region = region:east_china_region
				region = region:tibet_region
				region = region:indochina_region
			}
			dominant_culture ?= {
				NOT = { has_culture_group = culture_group:chinese_group }
			}
		}
	}

	release_country_enabled = {

		}

			limit = {

			limit = {
				exists = court_language
				court_language != scope:future_overlord.court_language
			}
			set_court_language = scope:future_overlord.court_dialect
		}
	}

		remove_list_global_variable = {

			target = root 
		}

		different_religion = -20
		same_common_language = 5
		same_court_language = 10
		different_culture = -10
		different_government_type = -25
		actor_at_war = -20

		tax_base = -0.25

# from in_game/common/subject_types/vassal.txt
REPLACE:vassal = {
	subject_pays = subject_pays_vassal
	color = subject_vassal
	level = 2
	annullment_favours_required = 20
	visible = {
		# High Kingship members can subjugate each other regardless of rank
		OR = {
			country_rank_level >= scope:target.country_rank_level
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:high_kingship
				any_international_organization_member = {
					this = scope:target
				}
			}
		}
		NOT = { has_advance = samanta_advance }
		scope:target = { subject_type_is_not_locked = yes }

		#Japanese Imperial Courts Exception
		trigger_if = {
			limit = {
				is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:japanese_shogunate
				is_situation_active = situation:nanbokuchou
			}
			NOT = {
				scope:target = {
					has_special_status_in_international_organization = {
						type = special_status:japanese_emperor
						international_organization = international_organization:japanese_shogunate
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	creation_visible = {
		NOT = { has_advance = samanta_advance }
	}
	
	join_offensive_wars_always = {
		NOR = {
			scope:actor ?= { is_subject_of = scope:recipient }
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = french_subject_prevented_from_call_to_war_join_war_tt
				scope:recipient ?= { modifier:french_subject_prevented_from_call_to_war = yes }
			}
		}
	}
	join_offensive_wars_can_call = {
		scope:actor ?= { is_subject_of = scope:recipient }
	}
	join_defensive_wars_always = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = french_subject_prevented_from_call_to_war_join_war_tt
			NOT = { scope:recipient ?= { modifier:french_subject_prevented_from_call_to_war = yes } }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = wont_be_auto_defended_by_overlord_join_war_tt
			NOT = { scope:actor ?= { has_variable = wont_be_auto_defended_by_overlord } }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = wont_join_vs_other_appanages_with_granted_autonomy_to_expand_modifier_during_hyw_tt
			NOT = { scope:target ?= { has_country_modifier = granted_autonomy_to_expand_modifier } }
		}
	}
	
	diplomatic_capacity_cost_scale = 1.0
	maritime_path_tolerance = -0.25


	strength_vs_overlord = -0.5
	
	has_overlords_ruler = no
	will_join_independence_wars = yes
	annexation_speed = 1
	annexation_min_years_before = 10
